d:
Shri hanuman ji ki puja aaradhna men sankat mochan hanuman ashtak ka niymit path karne se bhakton par aaye ganbhir sankat ka bhi nivaran ho jata hai.kisi bhi prakar ka kaisa bhi bhishan sankat ho sankatmochan hanuman ashtak ka pathan ya shravan atyant prabhavkari hota hai. us vyakti par hanuman ji kripa bani rahti hai ,unke aashirvad se har prakar ki badhaen dur hoti hain |
